quote: Jacobs took responsibility of operating and maintaining Vancouver's wastewater treatment plants in 2016. As part of the transition process Jacobs put together a comprehensive transition plan which made the process very positive, smooth and seamless for not only the City but also the existing staff that became Jacobs employees. There was a high degree of transparency…
speaker: Frank Dick, P.E.
title: Sewer and Wastewater Engineering Supervisor

quote: Despite the many challenges presented by the COVID-19 outbreak, Jacobs implemented a smooth and successful transition from our previous operator. Jacobs assembled a transition team of HR, operational, and technical professionals to implement their plan safely and efficiently. The plan included constant communication with the owner; a safe, private, and remote process for employees onboarding to Jacobs; and a technical team that applied their engineering and operational expertise to ensure that operations continued without interruption. Following a successful transition, we look forward to a continued partnership with Jacobs for many years to come.
speaker: Vincent R. Carroccia
title: Deputy Commissioner, Department of Public Works
